requirements.title: Native adoption mechanics retain judgment and verification boundaries
requirements.rationale: Mechanical dependency and identity handling must be deterministic without converting observations into consent or readiness into execution.

criteria.expected: Inspection reconstructs current dependency readiness without mutation, cached qualification or fabricated approval.
Complete preparation binds mechanical catalog/source identities and supplies unresolved adoption, cleanup, pipeline and capability fields; it cannot manufacture judgments or persist a ledger.
Every guarded migration interruption boundary resumes idempotently without discarding unrelated work.
Delivery uses its own review, current merged source and exact artifact subject; pre/post reviews, stale merge identity and wrong artifact cannot substitute.
The composed verifier requires an explicit stage and native identity before executing any canonical suite.
Static CI inspection distinguishes actual stage execution from readiness, optional or miswired checks, without claiming live provider qualification.
Local adoption controls and integrated CI qualification are separate; attributed or missing provider evidence cannot establish integration.

CI inspection distinguishes generic gate presence from actual selected-review argument routing at both stages; absent, partial, comment-only, conflicting and readiness-only handoffs stay unverified without executing or rewriting CI.

requirements.title: Existing local login and CI identity have distinct scopes

source.excerpt: missing job token never falls back to a developer login. Outside Actions, GitHub

requirements.rationale: Native review preparation should reuse authorized local tooling without leaking that identity into runners.

criteria.expected: Local GitHub reads preserve explicit credential precedence and may reuse the existing gh login; CI never silently substitutes that login for its configured job identity.
